sensitivePaths.reason: Control changes can weaken architectural/risk/security gates.
Security detection is a sensitive public contract.
Proof validation constrains agent completion and review.
CI is a repository admission control.
Dependency and executable contract changes need justified review.
Command argv, configured contract paths and proof requirements determine execution and admission.
Every shipped schema defines which configuration, evidence, review and work records are admitted.
Core owns path traversal, command execution, configuration/schema validation, risk, architecture, security, CI, audit, proof freshness and work admission.
Option parsing and dispatch determine whether command effects and privileged execution are permitted.
Capture/finalization/review writes determine which executed results are accepted as evidence.
Transitions mutate persisted work and enforce executable/reviewable/completed admission.
Bootstrap preserves user files and generates executable contracts, control policies and evidence protection.
Staging and reconciliation admit source inventories and pinned adaptation/license records before writes.
The shipped standalone runner resolves argv and owns command termination/failure propagation.
The tracked repository runner implements actual local execution, independent of the shipped asset.
The root dispatch wrapper selects the standalone runner and propagates its result.
The bootstrap dispatch wrapper determines the runner invoked in newly initialized repositories.
The admission script composes architecture/security/schema/skills gates and preserves failures.
The test admission script discovers suites and propagates actual failures.
The behavior admission script exercises execution, proof, audit and negative boundary scenarios.
Adoption applies reviewed governing-control and capability patches, checks execution authorization and persists original-byte recovery records.
Receipt import/export writes and externally selected verification delimit authenticated provider claims from local evidence.
Hosted CI provisioning verifies downloaded toolchain artifacts and controls executable installation and version admission.
